top_categories.workout_context: 81ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Amy's Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
At Amy's Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Amy's Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
6,119ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
76 miles on great Ocean Road coastal and Otway Ranges climbing burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Road-specific control matters at Amy's Gran Fondo. Practice on great Ocean Road coastal and Otway Ranges climbing: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 76 miles.
6,119ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on great Ocean Road coastal and Otway Ranges climbing can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,119ft of climbing on great Ocean Road coastal and Otway Ranges climbing does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Amy's Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Amy's Gran Fondo's 76 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and Over Under to prepare you for 76 miles of great ocean road coastal and otway ranges climbing in Lorne, Great Ocean Road, Victoria, Australia.
